description:
Get complete details of a specific offer by its UUID.

Returns a single offer object with all fields (including contact_method, specific_attributes, geo_scope).
Returns an error object with code "NOT_FOUND" if the ID doesn't exist.
The id parameter accepts a UUID, an offer URL like https://anygett.com/offers/<uuid>, or an offer title.

id.description: Offer UUID, an offer URL (https://anygett.com/offers/<uuid>), or an offer title. Get UUIDs from search_offers results.

name: get_offer_details
title: Get Offer Details
